item.title: Add OpenThomas to Prediction Markets (#823)
item.content:encoded:
Add OpenThomas to Prediction Markets (#823)

OpenThomas is an MIT-licensed autonomous weather-market trading agent for
Kalshi and Polymarket with an MCP server, per-station bias learning, and
fractional Kelly sizing under hard risk limits.
